info.title: AssemblyRefScanner
info.description: An assembly, type and member scanner.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: assemblyref
commands.description: Searches for references to the assembly with the specified simple name.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

arguments.name: SIMPLEASSEMBLYNAME
arguments.description: The simple assembly name (e.g. "StreamJsonRpc") to search for in referenced assembly lists.

commands.name: assembly
commands.description: Searches for assemblies with the specified simple name and prints their versions.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

arguments.name: SIMPLEASSEMBLYNAME
arguments.description: The simple assembly name (e.g. "StreamJsonRpc") to search for in referenced assembly lists.

commands.name: multiversions
commands.description: All assemblies that reference multiple versions of *any* assembly will be printed.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

commands.name: embeddedTypes
commands.description: Searches for assemblies that have embedded types.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

arguments.name: EMBEDDABLEASSEMBLIES
arguments.description: The path to an embeddable assembly.

commands.name: api
commands.description: Searches for references to a given type or member.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

options.name: --declaringAssembly
options.description: The simple name of the assembly that declares the API whose references are to be found.

arguments.name: DOCID
arguments.description: The DocID that identifies the API member to search for references to. A DocID for a given API may be obtained by compiling a C# program with GenerateDocumentationFile=true that references the API using <see cref="the-api" /> and then inspecting the compiler-generated .xml file for that reference.

commands.name: type
commands.description: Searches for references to a given type.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

options.name: --declaringAssembly
options.description: The simple name of the assembly that declares the API whose references are to be found.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of the type to find references to.

arguments.name: TYPENAME
arguments.description: The simple name of the type to find references to.

options.name: --path
options.description: The path of the directory to search. This should be a full install of VS (i.e. all workloads) to produce complete results. If not specified, the current directory will be searched. [default: <path>]

options.name: --dgml
options.description: The path to a .dgml file to be generated with all assemblies graphed with their dependencies and identified by TargetFramework.

options.name: --json
options.description: The path to a .json file that will contain the raw output of all assemblies scanned.

options.name: --include-runtime
options.description: Includes runtime assemblies in the output. [default: False]

commands.name: resolveReferences
commands.description: Lists paths to assemblies referenced by a given assembly.

options.name: --transitive
options.description: Resolves transitive assembly references in addition to the default direct references. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: The path to an .exe.config or .dll.config file to use to resolve references.

options.name: --base-dir
options.description: The path to the directory to consider the app base directory for resolving assemblies and relative paths in the .config file. If not specified, the default is the directory that contains the .config file if specified, or the directory containing the entry assembly.

options.name: --runtime-dir
options.description: The path to a .NET runtime directory where assemblies may also be resolved from. May be used more than once.

options.name: --exclude-runtime
options.description: Omits reporting assembly paths that are found in any of the specified runtime directories. [default: False]

arguments.name: ASSEMBLYPATH
arguments.description: The path to the assembly to search for assembly references.
